newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end higher in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end higher in all months.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed higher in all months on Monday, due to the Chicago market's price gains on Friday, local traders said.
Prices were 60 to 180 yen higher, with the benchmark March 1998 contract up 180 yen at 16,270 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 51,229 lots.

All months gained sharply at the opening, as active buying from individual investors emerged, traders said. Some contracts eased later as some investors conducted technical sales, they said. "Sentiment remained bullish and the soybean market's price rallies encouraged investors," a brokerage trader said.
The spot March corn contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $3.09 per bushel at 0930 GMT, against $3.07-1/4 at Friday's close.
The spot March CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $8.45 at 0930 GMT, down from $8.46 from Friday's close.
